answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment. Just as a walnut requires force to crack its shell, an attacker must secure a significant asset stake to influence a validator grove. If an adversary attempts to proliferate identities, their influence reaches a nadir because the cost of acquiring sufficient stake becomes prohibitively expensive, ensuring that consensus remains tied to economic skin-in-the-game rather than the mere volume of fraudulent nodes.
